title: NSC steps up southern safeguards
summary: The National Security Council (NSC) is stepping up preventive measures in the southern border provinces alongside peace talks, seeking to prevent further incidents and rebuild public trust.

title: Man arrested for mailing 36 grenade rounds from Narathiwat to Tak
summary: A man has been arrested in Pattani for allegedly sending 36 grenade launcher rounds through a parcel delivery service from Narathiwat to a buyer in Tak province.
